stemMd: An object's mass stays constant while its speed triples. By what factor does its kinetic energy increase?
explanationMd: Kinetic energy is one half mv squared. Replacing v by 3v multiplies v squared by 9, so energy becomes nine times its original value.

distractorRationale.c: This doubles the speed factor without squaring.
distractorRationale.b: Kinetic energy depends on speed squared.
